purpose: Determine whether source-resolved Mangal programmes retain enough repeated species-rank taxa to support a defensible evolutionary-time partner-profile arm before any interaction edge is opened.

qualification.repeated_definition: same taxonomy_id with taxonomy.rank=species occurs in at least two georeferenced networks within the programme
qualification.rationale: The generalized design requires at least 20 focal taxa and at least 10 repeated focal taxa. Before edge roles are opened, applying the threshold to all species-rank taxa is a necessary and conservative prefilter.

rank_rule: Only taxonomy.rank exactly equal to species contributes to this gate. Genus/family/higher-rank nodes are retained only as diagnostics and cannot rescue a failing programme.
name_rule: Taxon names may be opened only for future phylogeny crosswalk and are not used to alter dataset inclusion thresholds.
next_gate_if_pass: Freeze phylogeny-source hierarchy and test dated-tree coverage on the predeclared names before edge opening.
next_gate_if_hold: Do not lower the species-rank requirement; either proceed with the reduced eligible Mangal subset if >=8 development programmes remain or stop the Mangal evolutionary-time arm before edges.
